mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 3.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that boost corporate profit margins through wage growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.0%, or Rank IC for UNRATE < 4.0% is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong aggregate demand, increasing corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 102.0) signals robust manufacturing output expansion, increasing corporate earnings visibility and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 102.0, or Rank IC for INDPRO > 102.0 is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment consistently reduces corporate cost of capital, leading to immediate positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly non-farm payrolls increase above 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 200,000, or Rank IC for PAYEMS > 200000 is below 0.02.

failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 102.5, or Rank IC for INDPRO > 102.5 is below 0.02.
